svg.aria-label: An 18-move game of Chain Reaction on the 5 by 7 board, played by the app's own rules: cells explode at critical mass, capture their neighbours, and lime wins with a three-wave chain.

g.text: A cell bursts when its orbs reach its neighbour count
(2 in a corner, 3 on an edge, 4 inside), throws one
orb to each neighbour and takes it over. Bursts chain.
Lose every orb after your first move and you're out.
